svg.title: Protected data flow across trust zones
svg.desc: Web and Desktop clients send authenticated commands to the IDEA Server over HTTPS and never receive database or permanent Artifact-store credentials. Desktop sends only allowlisted manifest-scoped commands to a per-user Workspace process over protected local IPC. Office and CAD applications edit ordinary local files and receive no IDEA authority. Server owner Modules revalidate account, RBAC and business state before using relational and Artifact stores. Format work runs in an isolated one-job zone and returns an untrusted candidate for validation. Coordinated backup copies cross into a separately controlled recovery zone and cannot reopen service without exact reconciliation.
